title: Strategy and Metrics of the Payments scope is below its target

value.title: Strategy and Metrics of the Payments scope is below its target
value.description: The released assessment Payments 2026 Q2 scores 1.25 for Strategy and Metrics; the target of the scope is 2. The measures of the payments scope are not defined, so that nobody can tell whether the security work has an effect.
value.treatment-notes: Define the measures of the payments scope and review them every quarter.
